description: Software developer career pack for the Sidewinder course: team guidance plus skill development aimed at refining and improving the developer career — field how-tos (debugging and incident improvisation without proper tooling, shipping under constraints), career-skill entries (craft refinement, mentoring, leveling up), and team-play entries (on-call rotations, incident command, review culture, how teams coordinate and improvise together under pressure). Feeds the learning engine's personal-refinement sub-engine. Lawful software work only.
notes_for_main_builder: Draft of 44 entries in three kinds: 20 field how-tos (sw-general-developer-001 to 020), 12 career-skill (021-032), 12 team-play (033-044). All prerequisites resolve pack-locally to lower-numbered entries. Domain is 'general'. Ids normalized by coordinator to the framework law (curriculum/schema.py: sw-<domain>[-<pack>]-NNN); full file validates clean. Open question: should team-play entries later get a distinct domain or keep 'general' with kind discoverable from id ranges?
safety_posture: Lawful software work only, defensive posture only. Debugging, incident response, reliability, and team practices — no exploit writing, no bypass techniques, no offensive security content of any kind. Stop conditions escalate (page, roll back, declare incident) rather than circumvent. No credential exfiltration: fixtures are anonymized, tracing never uses production credentials from personal machines.

track_emphasis.build: secondary — health checks, feature flags, zero-downtime migrations, reliable jobs, runbooks
track_emphasis.combine: tertiary — script consolidation, pattern hybrids, pair programming as combined skill
track_emphasis.create: secondary — API contracts, decision records, postmortems, onboarding docs, game days
track_emphasis.improve: primary — profiling, N+1 taming, debugging intuition, estimation, code review, on-call fairness
track_emphasis.improvise: primary — Sidewinder doctrine core: no-debugger diagnosis, read-only-shell hotfixes, onboarding with no docs, incident command on a call and a doc
track_emphasis.restore: primary — crash diagnosis, bisection, rollbacks, flaky-test quarantine, corruption recovery
